title: Set up the integral
text: One arch corresponds to $$0 \leq theta \leq 2\pi$$. The area is the integral of $$y \frac{dx}{dtheta}$$ from $$0$$ to $$2\pi$$, which is the integral of $$r^2 \left(1-cos\left(\theta\right)\right)^2$$.

title: Evaluate
text: $$\left(1-cos\left(\theta\right)\right)^2=1-2cos\left(\theta\right)+cos^2\left(\theta\right)$$. Over $$[0,2\pi]$$ these terms integrate to $$2\pi$$, $$0$$, and pi, so the area is $$r^2 \left(2\pi+\pi\right)=3\pi r^2$$.
